Doug HauberReunionBlessingI’ve been asked to offer a prayer ofblessing for this event, for thosegathered here and your families,and for the food we are about to receive._____________________________Lord God,The paths of our lives have taken us far and wide,but it is surely a blessing for us to be able togather together after more than half a century.Over the years you have never left us alone,though at times we might have found ourselveswandering in deserted places. Help always toknow your presence, confident in your never-failing love.Grant your favor upon us and our families. Maywe work to better this world and the lives of allyour children.As we become more and more advanced in age,let us grow more deeply in the knowledge of youand your designs in our lives.Tonight we ask your blessing on this assembly,guide our conversation; bless the meal we willshare, those who prepared it, and those aroundthe world who will go to bed hungry.Above all, help us always to live and act as yourloving children, ready, one day, to be calledhome to you.We praise you and ask all things confident inyour loving mercy upon us.Amen.26
